body type: an hourglass figure with a subtly full bust, a slim waist and very wide, curvy rounded hips that flow smoothly into softly full thighs, the line tapering gradually toward the knees with no sudden narrowing below the hips, and slender lower legs — never thick or heavy
body scope: Body type sets the build; body details adjust within it. These describe anatomy beneath armor, not equipment volume.
